items.text: Puka Nacua listed IN for Sunday after hip injury; expected to return vs Eagles.
items.why: No designation on final report; returning from Week 1 hip injury.
items.implication: Boosts Rams WR corps and Adams/Nacua stack potential; monitor possible snap limits.
items.opportunity: Full or near-full route share expected vs depleted Eagles secondary/pass rush (Donald out).

items.text: Nico Collins listed IN; returning from hamstring vs Cowboys.
items.why: Full participant Friday; good to go per team report.
items.implication: Elite WR1 return in favorable matchup; Texans implied high total.
items.opportunity: High target share rebound vs Cowboys secondary that inflates WR scoring.

items.text: Justin Jefferson ruled OUT (ankle) for Week 4 vs Dolphins.
items.why: Did not practice; sprained ankle from Week 3.
items.implication: Major target vacuum in Vikings offense; Addison primary beneficiary.
items.opportunity: Jordan Addison elevated to alpha WR role home vs weak secondary.

items.text: DeVonta Smith and Dallas Goedert both OUT for Eagles vs Rams (hamstring/other).
items.why: Smith hamstring ruled out; Goedert also sidelined; Baun also out.
items.implication: Eagles passing attack severely depleted; hurts Jalen Hurts ceiling, boosts remaining WRs/TEs if any.
items.opportunity: Increased targets to remaining skill players; Rams defense benefits (Donald out too).

items.text: Breece Hall OUT (thigh) for Jets; also AD Mitchell and others.
items.why: Exited prior game; ruled out on final report.
items.implication: Jets RB committee shifts; backups elevated for full workload.
items.opportunity: Handcuff/backup RBs see 100% snaps potential vs Bears.

items.text: Mike Evans QUESTIONABLE (ribs); game-time decision, intends to play.
items.why: Rib injury; Shanahan GTD; Evans plans padded compression to play through.
items.implication: Monitor morning of; if out boosts Kittle/other 49ers.
items.opportunity: If active, full WR1 role; if INACTIVE, TE/WR2 upside.

items.text: Nacua return great but possible snap limits; Collins elite DvP vs Cowboys (+7.3% WR scoring); Addison truthers moment with Jefferson out home vs weak secondary. Eagles worse without Smith/Goedert/Baun.
items.why: DvP data, practice trends (McConkey LP-DNP-LP), Eagles absences, Addison opportunity.
items.implication: Start Collins confidently; fade Eagles pass game slightly; Addison must-start.
items.opportunity: Collins routes/targets spike; Addison target share surge; Nacua monitor limits.

items.text: De'Von Achane OUT (season-ending ACL per reports).
items.implication: Miami backfield completely reshuffled for ROS.
items.opportunity: Backup RBs and pass-catchers absorb all carries/targets.

items.text: Jadarian Price OUT (chest); Zach Charbonnet also listed OUT but practicing.
items.implication: Further limits Seahawks RB usage clarity short-term.

items.text: Jayden Daniels OUT (elbow); Caleb Williams also OUT.
items.why: Daniels left elbow; Williams hamstring; both miss another week.
items.implication: Backup QBs start; Commanders/Bears offenses capped.
items.opportunity: Reduced rushing upside; pass-catchers face lower efficiency.

items.text: Ladd McConkey QUESTIONABLE (foot); LP-DNP-LP practice week.
items.why: Foot issue after prior cracked rib; limited-to-DNP-limited.
items.implication: Risk of limited snaps or sit; Chargers WR depth tested.
items.opportunity: If out, Johnston/others elevated; if in, still volume but efficiency risk.

items.text: LOVE Jaylen Warren (90% snaps, Dowdle out, full workhorse vs CLE allowing RB yards); LOVE Jeremiyah Love (26 touches, high util vs NYG 5.1 YPC); LOVE Drake London (35%+ TS with Penix, vs NO).
items.why: Usage dominance (snaps/touches/TS), matchup data (YPC allowed, pass def).
items.implication: Strong start recommendations; Warren top-10 RB, Love volume play, London WR1.
items.opportunity: Warren 20+ touches locked; Love dual-threat; London high target share.

items.text: HATE Omarion Hampton (low 42% snaps, 3.5% TS, poor vs SEA run D); HATE Justin Herbert (high pressure, SEA elite pass D, low team total); HATE Emeka Egbuka (new QB, low RZ, low total); also Worthy/Pitts.
items.why: Poor utilization (snaps/routes/TS), tough matchups (pressure/YPA/YPC), script/total risks.
items.implication: Sit/fade these in most formats; prefer alternatives.
items.opportunity: Avoid low-floor plays; pivot to higher-usage options.

items.text: Jadarian Price tough month: lost GL/base to Wilson, pass work to Holani, fumbles, chest injury, Charbonnet practicing. Still passes eye test long-term; far from over.
items.why: Role erosion data + injury + Charbonnet return practice.
items.implication: Short-term fade; hold long-term if dynasty/keeper.
items.opportunity: Wilson/Holani short-term beneficiaries for GL/pass downs.
